scope: Canonical existing-object native reference ownership prerequisite; not a complete AsyncWrap/HandleWrap/ReqWrap implementation or startup proof.

upstreamConsumers.contract: OnClose acquires an existing HandleWrap, detaches it, updates close state and invokes the original close callback. OnGCCollect defers deletion until actual uv close completion.
Completion acquires the existing request wrapper, detaches it, updates waiting state and invokes the original completion. Dispatch strengthening and later weak restoration share the same owner.
Strong references clear weak JS ownership. Last detached release calls virtual OnGCCollect; otherwise requested weak ownership is restored. Detach is idempotent with a live native reference.
MakeDetachedBaseObject and copied native references must retain one deleting owner, independent of wrapper movement/collection.

contracts.implementation: One weakly indexed canonical std::shared_ptr cell per realm-owned BaseObject. Existing-object acquisition aliases that cell; independently deleting shared_ptr construction is unavailable.
contracts.errors: Foreground/active environment ownership is checked. Raw pointer validity remains the native caller contract; JavaScript probes reject ordinary, foreign and retired wrappers.

contracts.owner: SpiderMonkey traced strong roots and weak-zone registry
contracts.implementation: Actual unwrapped wrapper identity; real nursery promotion before weak registration; native references keep a strong JS edge; the last native release restores a tenured weak edge only when requested. Strengthening removes weak registry membership.
contracts.errors: Wrong owner/thread and premature nursery weakening fail invariants. Weak targets are not resurrected after collection.

contracts.owner: native resource class and canonical BaseObject reference cell
contracts.implementation: Detach requires a live native reference and is idempotent. Last detached release calls the virtual collection hook. Base collection retires the JS pointer before derived destruction; resources may defer actual deletion through uv_close.
contracts.errors: Outstanding native references cannot be freed behind their owner. Destruction/reentry observes the retired wrapper. Actual pending callback exceptions survive.

contracts.implementation: The finalizer clears the wrapper native slot before calling OnGCCollect. Native close completion may acquire an existing object without an active JavaScript callback frame.
contracts.errors: A collected wrapper with a live native reference is an invariant failure.
